summary: Mail delivery looks for an MX record and falls back to an A/AAAA record, even when a domain accepts no mail. This document defines a Null MX record that explicitly says a domain accepts no mail, so senders can stop right away instead of trying.

eli5.summary: This is a sign on a house saying: no mail delivered here. Senders see it and do not wait around trying.

questions: how to say a domain accepts no email
